title: The soil-biology evidence ladder has almost no rungs
subtitle: Share of the 448.4 million kg of pesticide applied to US cropland in 2018, sorted by the strongest study design that exists anywhere in EPA's ECOTOX release for four non-target soil functional groups. A tier counts only if at least two independent published studies support it.

x.label: Share of 2018 US applied pesticide mass (%)

series.label: Strongest design available
series.encoding_note: Ordered weakest to strongest. 'No record' and 'CAS unresolved' should read as absence (neutral grey, unresolved lighter/hatched); the two laboratory tiers as one cool hue ramping with design strength; the two field tiers as a distinct warm hue. The visual point is that the warm colours barely appear, and that the top two bars are almost entirely grey.

annotations.text: 98.8% of applied mass has no record of any kind. ECOTOX's entire soil bacteria and protozoa holding is 118 tests from 9 studies on 21 chemicals -- mostly rice-paddy cyanobacteria -- with one field test ever recorded.
96.3% has no field-scale earthworm evidence. Requiring two independent studies instead of one drops the share with field evidence from 41% to 2.5%: a single unreplicated test row was carrying it.
Glyphosate -- 26.6% of all applied mass -- has 8 test records from 2 studies on mycorrhizal fungi, and zero on soil bacteria.

No compound reaches multi-year field evidence for mycorrhizal fungi or soil bacteria. Only four compound x group cells reach it at all (chlorpyrifos, carbaryl, imidacloprid), together 0.87% of applied mass.

The soil-habitat record is not small: 137,463 tests from 11,457 studies. 94% of its field tests are on crop plants. EPA's data requirements table at 40 CFR 158.630 lists a honeybee test and no soil-organism test at all.

source_note: EPA ECOTOX ASCII release 09/15/2026 (tests.txt, results.txt, validation/species.txt, validation/chemicals.txt) joined by CAS via DTXSID to USGS Pesticide National Synthesis Project county use, 2018, corrected basis (California excluded, aggregate rows removed).
